sloka: धारा निपातैः अभिहन्यमानाःकदंब शाखासु विलंबमानाः ।क्षण अर्जितम् पुष्प रस अवगाढम्शनैर् मदम् षट् चरणाः त्यजन्ति ॥४-२८-२९॥
transliteration: dhārā nipātaiḥ abhihanyamānāḥkadaṁba śākhāsu vilaṁbamānāḥ ।kṣaṇa arjitam puṣpa rasa avagāḍhamśanair madam ṣaṭ caraṇāḥ tyajanti ॥4-28-29॥

translations.english: 'Having sucked honey from the flowercups filled with honey, the bees are shedding their drunkenness slowly and hanging on the branches of kadamba trees, smitten with showers.
